capability.date_check: Compares the current time with a date: {subject}.
capability.dependency_outside_pypi: Declares a dependency outside the supported PyPI requirement format: {subject}.
capability.deserialize: Loads serialized data with an operation that can run code: {subject}.
capability.dynamic_attribute: Looks up a module attribute dynamically: {subject}.
capability.dynamic_code: References an operation that runs or compiles code from text: {subject}.
capability.file_access: Names or opens a file path: {subject}.
capability.ha_auth: References Home Assistant users or tokens: {subject}.
capability.ha_config_entries: References saved integration settings, which may include credentials: {subject}.
capability.ha_http_middleware: References Home Assistant HTTP middleware, which can inspect requests: {subject}.
capability.ha_private_file: Names a Home Assistant file that may contain private data: {subject}.
capability.http_request: Source calls an HTTP request API with destination {subject}. This does not establish that traffic was sent.
capability.network_host: Names a network host: {subject}. This does not prove that traffic was sent.
capability.process: Names a program or process operation: {subject}.
capability.shipped_binary: Includes a compiled or executable file: {subject}.
capability.symlink: Includes a symbolic link: {subject}. Doorcheck did not follow it.
capability.system_module: Imports a module with system access: {subject}.
capability.web_view: Defines a web view: {subject}. Authentication depends on its configuration.
capability.ha_frontend_script: Source registers extra frontend JavaScript with destination {subject}. ES5 option: {es5}. This does not establish that the script was loaded or executed.
capability.ha_static_path: Source constructs a Home Assistant static-path configuration: {subject}. URL path: {url_path}. Resource path: {path}. Cache-headers option: {cache_headers}. This does not establish registration, authentication or network reachability.

capability.webhook: Registers a Home Assistant webhook: {subject}. Local-only option: {local_only}. This does not establish network reachability.
cli.compare_limited: Comparison is limited: target names, engine/check versions or complete check coverage do not match in the reports.
cli.compare_matched: Target names, engine/check versions and complete check coverage match in the reports.
cli.compare_scope: Comparison of reported observations only. Absence does not prove a fix. Inspect both reports: scan roots, tool behavior and authenticity are not verified by this command.
cli.help:
Usage: doorcheck scan (FOLDER | --repo OWNER/REPO (--commit SHA | --tag TAG)) [--json | --sarif]

Read a local folder or fetch a GitHub integration at an explicit tag or full lowercase 40-character commit SHA, without executing its code. Default output is plain text.
JSON contains the versioned report; SARIF contains findings and coverage notifications.
Only the source capability reader and the Python unauthenticated file-read rule run.
Only --repo downloads files, using bounded GitHub-only fetching and safe temporary extraction.
Repository targets use Marketplace integration file selection; --tag also supports named release-file installs.
Tags may move. Reports retain the observed source commit and installed-file digest; release-file bytes need not match source.
No dependency advisory checks or external scanners run.

Exit codes: 0 = complete, no Review/Serious findings; 1 = Review/Serious findings;
2 = incomplete scan or invalid arguments; 130 = interrupted. Coverage gaps take precedence.
Use -- before a folder whose name starts with a dash.
Help: doorcheck --help or doorcheck scan --help.

Compare saved reports offline:
  doorcheck compare BEFORE.json AFTER.json [--json]
Report inputs must be regular files of at most 20 MiB each.
Text shows removed and added observations with both reports' coverage and versions.
JSON includes original reports, changes and a metadata_matches flag; there is no comparison SARIF.
Comparison exit codes: 0 = matching metadata/complete checks, no added Review/Serious findings;
1 = matching metadata/complete checks, added Review/Serious findings;
2 = gaps, metadata mismatch, invalid input/arguments or output failure; 130 = interrupted.
A removal does not prove a fix. Only report data is compared; no source is rescanned.
Help: doorcheck compare --help.
cli.invalid_arguments: Invalid arguments. Use doorcheck --help for scan and compare usage.
cli.output_failed: Doorcheck could not finish reading or writing output. Results are incomplete.
cli.report_invalid: Doorcheck could not read a supported report from {path}. Use a regular UTF-8 report JSON file of at most 20 MiB, with supported fields, unique JSON keys and valid message keys/parameters.
cli.scope: Coverage: source capability reader and Python unauthenticated file-read rule only. No dependency advisories or external scanners. A completed check does not establish safety; code downloaded later and runtime behavior are not covered.
finding.known_vulnerability: Package {package} at version {version} is listed in vulnerability advisories {ids}. {summary}
finding.malicious_package: Package {package} at version {version} is listed in OSV malware advisories {ids}. {summary}
finding.unauth_file_path: An unauthenticated web view passes a route path to a file read.
finding.unauth_file_path_action: Review path confinement and authentication. Restrict reads to the intended directory and test traversal attempts; require authentication when serving private files.
finding.unauth_file_path_detail: The route accepts path separators. Doorcheck traced its value to a file operation without a recognized transformation. Static analysis does not establish which files are reachable.
presentation.info_description: An observation about what the source contains or can do.
presentation.intro: Shared visual foundations for source observations and scan coverage. Shapes and words carry meaning together.
presentation.none_description: These checks found no observations. This does not establish safety.
presentation.notice_description: An observation worth understanding in context.
presentation.review_description: An observation to review before deciding what to install or change.
presentation.rtl_note: Layout test only; English messages remain untranslated. Mixed-direction source values are isolated.
presentation.serious_description: An observation that needs prompt attention. Read the evidence and context.
presentation.title: See the observation. Know the limits.
presentation.unavailable_description: The scan did not run or failed. Results are unavailable.
problem.conflicting_requirements: Conflicting versions are declared for this dependency. It was not checked.
problem.dependency_not_checked: The scanner did not report a result for this dependency. It was not checked.
problem.directory_not_readable: Doorcheck could not read this directory. Some files were not checked.
problem.download_failed: Doorcheck could not download the requested file.
problem.download_not_found: The requested download was not found.
problem.download_refused: Doorcheck refused this download because the address does not meet the download safety requirements.
problem.download_too_large: The download exceeds the size limit and was not used.
problem.fetch_failed: Doorcheck could not retrieve the files to scan.
problem.file_not_parsed: A scanner could not parse this file. Its contents were not fully checked.
problem.file_not_readable: Doorcheck could not read this file. It was not checked.
problem.file_not_regular: This entry is not a regular file and was not read.
problem.file_not_scanned: The scanner skipped this file. It was not checked by that scanner.
problem.file_path_not_supported: A source file path cannot be represented in this report: {path}. The file was not checked.
problem.file_too_complex: This file exceeds the parser complexity limit and was not fully checked.
problem.file_too_large: This file exceeds the scan size limit and was not fully checked.
problem.manifest_not_parsed: Doorcheck could not parse the manifest, so its declarations were not fully checked.
problem.manifest_not_readable: Doorcheck could not read the manifest, so its dependencies were not checked.
problem.no_matching_release: No matching package release was found, so this dependency was not checked.
problem.no_rules: The scanner has no rules configured and did not run.
problem.package_index_unreadable: Doorcheck could not read the package index, so this dependency was not resolved.
problem.requirement_extras_not_checked: Dependencies requested by this requirement’s extras were not checked.
problem.requirement_not_text: A dependency declaration is not text and was not checked.
problem.requirement_outside_pypi: This dependency is not a supported PyPI requirement and was not checked.
problem.requirements_not_list: The manifest requirements are not a list, so dependencies were not checked.
problem.scan_limit_reached: The scan reached a resource limit. Some files were not checked.
problem.target_not_directory: The target must be a readable local directory. Files and symbolic-link roots are not accepted.
problem.too_many_files: The file count exceeds the scanner limit. The scanner did not run.
problem.too_many_requirements: The dependency count exceeds the scan limit. Additional dependencies were not checked.
problem.tool_check_failed: The scanner could not complete check “{check}”: {detail}
problem.tool_failed: The scanner failed. Its results are unavailable.
problem.tool_not_installed: The scanner could not be started. Its results are unavailable.
problem.tool_output_not_understood: Doorcheck could not understand the scanner output. Its results are unavailable.
problem.tool_output_too_large: The scanner output exceeds the size limit. Its results are unavailable.
problem.tool_timed_out: The scanner exceeded its time limit. Its results are unavailable.
problem.tool_wrong_version: The installed scanner version does not match the required version. It did not run.
problem.unexpected: Doorcheck could not finish this operation because of an unexpected error.
problem.unsafe_archive: Doorcheck refused to extract this archive because it does not meet the extraction safety requirements.
